role: Canonical Caduceus benchmark timing report; top-level reports are flag-gated and trace stamps carry a minimal row

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Top-level benchmark reports remain absent unless the existing benchmark flag is present and true. Every valid load-context invocation carries a minimal one-row timing report in its trace stamp; the flag may request additional detail.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
